votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — KIDS Act (H R 7757)
votes.plain_language: This bill requires specified online platforms to establish safeguards for minors. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — Small Business Technological Advancement Act (H R 915)
votes.plain_language: This bill authorizes the Small Business Administration to finance, under its 7(a) loan program, business software or cloud computing services, including tools that use artificial intelligence. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act (H R 7401)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Lending Fraud Prevention Act
votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Administration employees who take part in originating, reviewing, or approving agency loans to certify in writing that they have no conflict of interest with the loan and to disclose any conflict that arises later. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act (S 3971)
votes.bill_title: Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act
votes.plain_language: This bill reauthorizes through FY2031 and modifies the Small Business Innovation Research program, the Small Business Technology Transfer program, and related pilot programs. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — AI for Main Street Act (H R 5764)
votes.plain_language: This bill requires Small Business Development Centers to assist small businesses in evaluating artificial intelligence, including by providing best practices for using artificial intelligence and guidance about using artificial intelligence to plan for unexpected circumstances. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass — Main Street Parity Act (H R 5763)
votes.plain_language: This bill lessens the financing requirements for certain Small Business Administration loans to small businesses for plant acquisition, construction, conversion, or expansion, including the acquisition of land. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it; a Nay opposes it.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.

posts.text:
Our veterans answered the call without hesitation - the least Congress can do is answer theirs.

This Veterans Day, we must move past words and pass legislation to guarantee robust benefits for all who have served.

As temperatures begin to drop, it is important to plan for the cold. The Home Energy Assistance Program (HEAP) is now open and can help cover heating costs for low-income families.

Call 1-800-342-3009 or visit https://t.co/gE5DPLKe8G for more information. https://t.co/rp6mYQCoO3
Happy Diwali! As we celebrate light over darkness, may your homes be filled with love, joy, and prosperity🪔

Tihar ko hardik shubhakamana to our Nepali neighbors!

Tihar reminds us to honor every bond that sustains us, from the animals who share our lives to the siblings who protect us. May it bring you happiness, prosperity, and peace.

Earlier this year, I questioned CVS Health CEO Joyner about his company’s monopoly.

After months of pressure, CVS decided to dump one part of their monopoly to get ahead of Congress reining them in.

We won’t be fooled. Next year, we’re breaking them up. https://t.co/mJ77qRZokO

If you witness any attempt to coerce voters or impede the right to vote, you can report it to the office of the New York State Attorney General by calling the Election Protection Hotline at (866) 390-2992 or https://t.co/oaHplxWR98

🗳️ NY-14, today is Election Day! Polling places are open until 9PM tonight. Make your voice heard and VOTE!

To find your poll site, visit https://t.co/vquCMuf9eG.
My statement on the devastating passing of Dolores Huerta⬇️ https://t.co/g5sbyMglbv
Yesterday, Brazil showed the world that the will of the people is stronger than the authoritarians who try to suppress it. Congratulations President @LulaOficial and congratulations Brazil.

Over the last week, I have received outreach from Albanian community members who are worried about their families' safety.

I am calling on the Albanian government to deescalate the violent repression of protestors and respect Albanians’ freedom of expression.
My statement on the suspicious letter sent to my district office in Hunts Point. https://t.co/K3VS20lhO7

The FAA rolled out a new AI tool for air traffic control in DC without publishing a safety evaluation or sufficiently consulting labor.

@RepAprilDelaney and I are urging the FAA to stop the rollout until we have answers. Air traffic control leaves zero margin for error.

On this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, we celebrate the endless and bountiful contributions of Native people.

Let us continue to center their voices and wisdom, and staunchly advocate for their community and land prosperity, especially as it relates to climate change.

For years, the Trump admin has launched slanderous attacks against Rep. Omar. This morning, the administration sent federal officials to raid her home.

We cannot and will not accept this unprecedented abuse of power. I stand with @Ilhan. https://t.co/e3KntPcs5Q
My statement on the ICE shooting in Marble Hill ⬇️ https://t.co/eDXEv5Vxrr

On Tuesday, @GovKathyHochul @RepPatRyanNY and I had the opportunity to speak with farming communities and spotlight a New York State moratorium on data center construction.

We must hold Big Tech companies accountable for maintaining our air, water, and climate quality. https://t.co/SqEWAHUdcB

It’s not too late to join the 2026 Congressional App Challenge!

The deadline to submit projects for the challenge is October 26, 2026 at 12:00 pm ET.

NY-14 students can register here⬇️
https://t.co/bqbDvQrOFV

Big Tech companies like Flock Safety have built a mass surveillance system to harvest Americans’ private and personal data without their consent.

I’m proud to introduce the Ban Flock Act with @SenSanders to enforce our constitutional right to privacy.

Republicans’ OBBBA specifically targeted New York by stripping 450,000 New Yorkers of their health insurance.

I'm proud to introduce the Restoring Essential Plan Coverage Act with @SenSchumer to reinstate federal funding for the Essential Plan and protect our communities. https://t.co/ypWjv3r4qg

On Friday, an explosion in central Athens took the lives of 6 people, including 4 New Yorkers. 

I am sending my deepest condolences to the families of Florin Hoxha, Eris Cani, Ian Kirkpatrick, Florida Hoxha, and all our NY-14 constituents impacted by this tragedy.

Additional flooding information: 

1️⃣ If you live in a basement apartment, relocate to a higher location.

2️⃣If you see a downed tree or a clogged catch basin, report it at https://t.co/3SvlXoekcE.

3️⃣If your property was damaged, report it at https://t.co/gLWA2kR3B6

As heavy rain and flooding continues to impact our city, it's important to monitor the latest forecasts and avoid unnecessary travel.

If you must travel, never walk/drive into flooded areas and sign up for @NotifyNYC to receive emergency notifications. Stay safe, NY-14. https://t.co/Zex9uDARKv

G'mar chatimah tova to all those observing Yom Kippur in NY-14 and across the globe.

We hope this Yom Kippur brings you and your loved ones peace and many blessings, and may you all have a meaningful fast.

I'm proud to announce that we secured $351 million for flood prevention in The Bronx and Queens in the Water Resources Development Act.

This funding will go directly toward projects that will protect our community from flash floods. https://t.co/I9NhD2H4UA

This Hispanic Heritage Month, we honor the generations of immigrants, activists, artists, and trailblazers who paved the way for us.

Our community thrives together. Let us hold each other close as we continue to fight for our collective prosperity.

Read More ⬇️
https://t.co/30JY2GMmXa

Across the country, private equity and corporations are buying up doctors' offices, leading to patients paying more for worse care.

@RepValHoyle and I are introducing the Stop Corporate Takeovers of Physicians Act to get Wall Street out of Americans’ doctors’ offices.

Shana Tovah to all those celebrating Rosh Hashanah in NY-14 and across the globe! 

We are wishing you and your loved ones a new year filled with peace, joy, and sweet blessings! 🍎🍯

On this 25th anniversary, we mourn the thousands of lives lost on 9/11. Our hearts are with their loved ones.

Let us also honor the courageous first responders who gave their all in our darkest hour.

We will #NeverForget their bravery in the face of such terrifying tragedy.

This year, there have already been 10 reported hangings of Black people in the U.S.

I’m proud to have signed onto @RepPressley ‘s letter to address these widespread modern-day lynchings and put a stop to this racial terror. https://t.co/ISo20mbLyg

Our office is currently hiring a veteran for a two-year position in our Hunts Point district office through the Green & Gold Congressional Aide Program.

To qualify, veterans must meet the specific requirements of the program.

Learn more here: https://t.co/Sv7LalaLIR

The 2026 Summer Reading Challenge has officially ended.

This weekend, we gathered with friends and loved ones at the World's Borough Bookshop in Jackson Heights to celebrate our summer readers.

We look forward to seeing you again next year. Keep reading, NY-14! https://t.co/N17dN2NuMa

New York City has one of the highest rates of childhood asthma in the country.

The BUSES Act would directly target New York's bus idling restrictions.

If Republicans want this for their kids, that's their business. But I will not allow this to be done to mine. https://t.co/rsA2Lwo082

As we mourn the loss of a trailblazer and a warrior, let us remember the innate kindness that Gloria Steinem brought to her advocacy.

She was a true leader, and will be dearly missed as we continue to fight for women everywhere.

Attention NY-14: You have just ONE day left to participate in the 2026 Summer Reading Challenge!

If you have completed your 10 books for the summer, please make sure to submit a picture of your log to my office by tomorrow at 6pm.

Learn more: https://t.co/DENqRW6yiU

There are just 5 days left for constituents to participate in the NY-14 Summer Reading Challenge!

All you have to do is read 10 books and submit your completed log to my office by September 1st.

Learn more: https://t.co/DENqRW6yiU

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

funding.heading: Disclosed campaign receipts
funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.

town_halls.note: There is no national town-hall dataset. Dates are not estimated.

disclosure_note: Disclosed contributions only; donors behind groups that do not report their own donors are not in this feed.
vote_scope: This is not a full career record. The cache is the latest 40 House rolls (2026, rolls 275-314) and 40 Senate votes (119th Congress, session 2, votes 217-256).
